description: Heavy rail hourly frequency, 2018-2040 scenarios is a series of data sets listed in data.gov.il, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministry of Transport and Road Safety. Coverage: Israel. The portal lists 5 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. Its title on the portal is "רכבת כבדה - תדירות שעתית 2026" (Hebrew). The portal files it under the publisher Ministry of Transport and Road Safety. Its tags are 2026, GIS, חצב, ממג, נפחי תנועה. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-06-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-il-portal.
